intro_commit_message: lavf: move demuxing-specific fields from FFFormatContext to FormatContextInternal
fix_commit_message:
avformat/avformat: also clear FFFormatContext packet queue when closing a muxer

packet_buffer is used in mux.c, and if a muxing process fails at a point where
packets remained in said queue, they will leak.

Fixes ticket #11419

Signed-off-by: James Almer <jamrial@gmail.com>
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix c08d300481b8 on top of intro cb80ec0b6cd7 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError): When demuxing-specific fields (parse_queue, raw_packet_buffer, raw_packet_buffer_size) were moved from FFFormatContext to FormatContextInternal, the call to ff_flush_packet_queue() in avformat_free_context() was guarded with 'if (s->iformat)' to prevent accessing demuxer-only fields on muxer contexts. However, ff_flush_packet_queue() also frees si->packet_buffer, which resides on FFFormatContext and is used by muxers (in mux.c via ff_interleave_add_packet). By guarding the entire ff_flush_packet_queue() call behind s->iformat, the muxer's packet_buffer is never freed when the format context is destroyed. If a muxing process fails while packets remain in the interleaving queue, those packets will leak. Root cause: The commit cb80ec0b moved parse_queue, raw_packet_buffer, and raw_packet_buffer_size to FormatContextInternal (demuxer-only). To prevent invalid memory access on muxer contexts, the entire ff_flush_packet_queue() call was guarded behind 'if (s->iformat)'. However, ff_flush_packet_queue() also clears si->packet_buffer which lives on FFFormatContext (accessible for both muxers and demuxers). The overly broad guard prevents packet_buffer from being freed for muxers.
